title: HR Recruiter (International Recruitment)
description:
Position: HR Recruiter International Recruitment
 Experience: 3-7 Years
 Location: Doddaballapura, Bengaluru Rural, Karnataka
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 About the Role 
 The HR Recruiter will be responsible for managing the end-to-end recruitment and staffing process for international hiring requirements across different countries and regions. The role involves understanding manpower requirements, developing sourcing strategies, identifying and screening candidates, coordinating interviews across time zones, managing offers, and supporting onboarding.
 The recruiter will work closely with international clients, hiring managers, business stakeholders, and candidates across different geographies to ensure timely closure of positions while delivering a professional and positive candidate experience.
 Key Responsibilities
 1. Talent Acquisition & Staffing
 Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle for international positions.
 Understand manpower requirements and develop effective recruitment strategies.
 Source candidates through LinkedIn, international job portals, social media, referrals, professional networks, and recruitment databases.
 Build and maintain strong talent pipelines across international markets.
 Handle volume hiring and specialized recruitment requirements as needed.
 2. Candidate Sourcing & Screening
 Identify and attract qualified candidates across different countries and talent markets.
 Review resumes and shortlist candidates based on job requirements.
 Conduct initial screening interviews to evaluate qualifications, experience, communication skills, availability, compensation expectations, and overall suitability.
 Use Boolean search and advanced sourcing techniques to identify suitable candidates.
 Maintain regular candidate engagement throughout the recruitment process.
 3. International Recruitment
 Manage recruitment requirements across international markets.
 Understand talent availability, recruitment practices, and candidate expectations across different countries.
 Coordinate with candidates and clients across multiple time zones.
 Familiarize yourself with country-specific employment practices, work authorization requirements, and hiring procedures.
 Coordinate recruitment documentation, verification, interview scheduling, and pre-joining formalities as required.
 4. Interviewing & Assessment
 Conduct structured recruiter screening interviews based on defined job requirements.
 Coordinate technical, managerial, and client interviews.
 Schedule interviews across different locations and time zones.
 Collect interview feedback and ensure timely communication with candidates and stakeholders.
 Follow up with candidates and clients to ensure smooth progress throughout the selection process.
 5. Client & Stakeholder Management
 Work closely with international clients, hiring managers, and business stakeholders to understand recruitment requirements.
 Coordinate candidate submissions, interviews, feedback, and recruitment updates.
 Provide regular updates on open positions, candidate pipelines, interview status, and hiring progress.
 Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders across different geographies.
 6. Offer Management & Negotiation
 Coordinate the offer process for selected candidates.
 Communicate compensation, benefits, employment terms, and joining requirements.
 Negotiate offers within approved guidelines.
 Manage candidate expectations and minimize offer dropouts through effective engagement.
 Follow up with selected candidates until successful joining.
 7. Recruitment Operations & Technology
 Maintain accurate candidate information in ATS/CRM systems and recruitment databases.
 Track candidate pipelines, interviews, feedback, offers, and joining status.
 Prepare recruitment reports and dashboards covering hiring progress, source effectiveness, time-to-fill, and other recruitment metrics.
 Leverage recruitment technology and sourcing tools to improve hiring efficiency.
 8. Compliance & Documentation
 Follow applicable recruitment policies, client requirements, and relevant hiring procedures.
 Coordinate candidate documentation and verification as required.
 Ensure appropriate handling of work authorization information and country-specific recruitment documentation.
 Maintain accurate, confidential, and up-to-date recruitment records.
 9. Candidate Experience & Relationship Management
 Represent Navinyaa professionally throughout the recruitment process.
 Ensure a positive candidate experience from initial interaction through onboarding.
 Maintain timely and transparent communication with candidates.
 Build long-term relationships with candidates across international talent markets.
 10. Recruitment Strategy & Market Research
 Identify new talent pools and sourcing channels across international markets.
 Research talent availability, compensation trends, and recruitment market developments.
 Develop alternative sourcing strategies for difficult-to-fill positions.
 Stay updated on recruitment technologies, sourcing techniques, and international hiring practices.
 Requirements
 Education
 Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
 Master's degree/MBA/PGDM in HR or a related field is preferred.
 Experience
 37 years of proven experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, or staffing.
 Hands-on experience in US, Uk and International Recruitment Experience.
 Experience managing end-to-end recruitment for international clients and overseas positions.
 Experience handling multiple recruitment requirements across different geographies.
 Experience working with staffing companies, recruitment consultancies, or international clients is preferred.
 Recruitment & Technical Skills 
 Strong sourcing and candidate identification skills.
 Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, international job portals, recruitment databases, and other sourcing platforms.
 Good understanding of Boolean search and advanced sourcing techniques.
 Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
 Ability to prepare recruitment trackers, reports, dashboards, and recruitment analytics.
 Communication & Interpersonal Skills 
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
 Strong interviewing, candidate engagement, negotiation, and persuasion skills.
 Ability to communicate effectively with international clients, candidates, and stakeholders.
 Strong relationship-building and stakeholder-management skills.
 Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
 Preferred Skills 
 Experience in overseas recruitment and international staffing.
 Exposure to recruitment across multiple countries or regions.
 Familiarity with international hiring processes and documentation.
 Experience working with international clients and stakeholders.
 Flexibility to work across different time zones based on business requirements.
 Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

description:
Job Summary Talent Acquisition Lead India | Global Talent Acquisition Shift Timing - IST 5 PM - 2 AM Overview of Position The Talent Acquisition Lead is responsible for implementing talent acquisition processes across Diversified s global operations, including the US, Canada, EMEA, Australia and India. Based in Bangalore, this position will lead, guide, and coach Talent Acquisition Specialists supporting sourcing, interview scheduling, and offer coordination, helping deliver consistent service and an outstanding experience for internal and external candidates. The Talent Acquisition Lead partners with global (US-based) Talent Acquisition leadership, regional HR teams, and hiring leaders to translate agreed processes into practical workflows, support adoption, and contribute ideas for improvement. Success requires demonstrated experience implementing comparable recruitment processes across regions, excellent spoken and written English, and the ability to use ATS and candidate data to improve hiring efficiency and service quality. Key Accountabilities Implement talent acquisition processes globally, adapting execution to regional requirements in partnership with local HR while maintaining consistent standards. Develop and execute rollout plans covering process documentation, responsibilities, training, milestones, and adoption tracking; identify barriers and coordinate practical solutions with the appropriate leaders. Establish clear workflows and service expectations from requisition intake through sourcing, interview scheduling, offer coordination, and handoff to onboarding. Lead, guide, and coach Talent Acquisition Specialists through training, regular feedback, quality reviews, and hands-on support for complex or urgent needs. Help coordinate team priorities, monitor capacity and service delivery, and work with the appropriate leaders to address bottlenecks across regions and time zones. Ensure sourcing aligns with role requirements and agreed recruiting strategies, interview scheduling is responsive, and offer documentation and approvals are accurate and timely. Work collaboratively with senior leaders and hiring teams to understand hiring needs, share progress, and contribute practical ideas that support effective recruitment. Partner with recruiters, HRBPs, hiring managers, and external recruitment partners to clarify responsibilities, address questions, and support consistent follow-through. Provide a professional, respectful candidate experience through timely updates, clear interview instructions, reliable coordination, and appropriate communication when candidates are not selected. Gather candidate and hiring manager feedback and implement improvements to communication, scheduling, and offer processes that reflect Diversified s values and employer brand. Partner with HR Operations and technology teams to align ATS workflows, templates, approvals, and reporting with the global process; support consistent system use and accurate records. Analyze ATS utilization, open requisition aging, time to fill, time to hire, time in stage, sourcing effectiveness, candidate conversion, withdrawals, and offer acceptance. Prepare recurring dashboards and concise reporting that explain trends, identify bottlenecks, recommend actions, and track the impact of process improvements. Establish consistent metric definitions and data quality checks with HR Operations; protect candidate confidentiality and follow company policies and applicable regional requirements in partnership with local HR. Qualifications Education Education: Bachelor s degree in Human Resources, Business, or a related field preferred; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience will be considered. Experience 8+ years of progressive talent acquisition or recruitment operations experience, including at least 3 years leading, guiding, and coaching a recruitment or talent acquisition support team. Global Implementation Experience: Demonstrated success implementing standardized recruitment processes across multiple countries or regions, including supporting US stakeholders from India or another global delivery location. Must provide concrete examples of personal ownership from planning through adoption and measurable outcomes. Team Leadership: Proven experience leading, guiding, and coaching specialists responsible for sourcing, interview scheduling, and offer preparation or coordination. English Communication: Excellent spoken and written English is essential, including the ability to participate effectively in discussions with senior leaders, share ideas clearly, write polished candidate communications, and explain data and process changes. Systems and Analytics: Strong working knowledge of enterprise ATS platforms, recruitment workflows, reporting, and data quality practices. Strong Excel skills and the ability to translate recruitment data into practical recommendations. Dayforce ATS and Power BI experience preferred. Skills and Competencies Strong relationship-building, coaching, process implementation, problem-solving, and organizational skills; sound judgment and the ability to balance competing priorities and support change. Global Collaboration: Ability to work across cultures and time zones, with planned overlap with US and other regional business hours. Industry Experience: Experience supporting technology, engineering, or project delivery recruitment preferred. Key Success Metrics Delivers agreed global rollout milestones and achieves consistent process adoption across participating regions. Strengthens specialist capability and improves responsiveness, accuracy, and completion of sourcing, scheduling, and offer coordination activities. Improves ATS utilization, data completeness, and timely updates to requisition and candidate records. Reduces avoidable delays, aged open requisitions, and time spent in hiring stages against agreed baselines and targets. Improves candidate and hiring manager feedback, candidate progression, and offer acceptance through better communication and coordination. Provides accurate, timely reporting and recommendations that result in measurable recruitment process improvements.

title: AM / M - Talent Acquisition
description:
Assistant Manager 
Technology | Campus | Corporate Functions
 Experience: 14 years;  fresh graduates may apply.
Individual contributor | Reports to Head – Talent Acquisition / CHRO
 THE OPPORTUNITY 
Own recruitment for assigned business requirements, from role intake and sourcing to offer closure and joining. Applicants may specialise in one or more tracks below; experience across all three is not required.
 WHAT YOU WILL DO 
• Business alignment: Translate business growth and capability priorities into hiring plans, sourcing strategies and relevant talent pipelines.
• Role intake and sourcing: Agree role requirements and timelines with hiring managers; source through portals, networks, referrals and direct outreach.
• Screening: Assess relevant skills and experience; discuss candidate interest, compensation, notice period and location.
• Selection: Coordinate interviews and assessments, secure timely feedback and maintain clear candidate communication.
• Offers and joining: Manage negotiations within approved budgets, pre-joining engagement and joining follow-ups.
• Recruitment operations: Maintain accurate records; track turnaround time, pipeline conversion, offer acceptance and offer-to-joining conversion.
• Market insights: Share talent availability, compensation expectations and hiring challenges; recommend practical process improvements.
 HIRING TRACKS 
• TECHNOLOGY: Recruit software engineers across backend, frontend and full-stack, plus QA, DevOps, data science and AI/ML. Build relevant talent pools and partner with engineering managers on screening criteria and assessments.
• CAMPUS: Build placement-team relationships and institute maps; coordinate campus calendars, internships, graduate/management trainee drives, assessments, offers, PPO processes and joining.
• CORPORATE FUNCTIONS: Recruit across Legal, HR, Marketing and IT. Tailor sourcing to specialist requirements, map relevant organisations and build pipelines for current and future needs.
 WHAT YOU WILL BRING 
• Completed full-time postgraduate qualification in HR or a relevant management discipline from a Tier 1 institute.
• 1–4 years of recruitment experience, with relevant exposure to at least one of Technology, Campus or Corporate Functions hiring.
• Strong sourcing, screening, stakeholder management and negotiation skills; disciplined follow-up and the ability to manage multiple requisitions.
• Clear communication, ownership, sound judgement and comfort using recruitment data to improve delivery and candidate experience.

title: Maintenance Executive
description:
Job Summary 
 Job Title: Maintenance Assistant Department: Maintenance Reporting to: Assistant Manager Projects Maintenance 

 Responsibilities 
 Assemble, install, test, and maintain electrical or electronic wiring, equipment, appliances, apparatus, and fixtures, using hand tools and power tools. Diagnose malfunctioning systems, apparatus, and components, using test equipment and hand tools, to locate the cause of a breakdown and correct the problem. Connect wires to circuit breakers, transformers, or other components. Inspect electrical systems, equipment, and components to identify hazards, defects, and the need for adjustment or repair, and to ensure compliance with codes. Advise management on whether continued operation of equipment could be hazardous. Test electrical systems and continuity of circuits in electrical wiring, equipment, and fixtures, using testing devices such as ohmmeters, voltmeters, and oscilloscopes, to ensure compatibility and safety of system. Maintain current electricians license or identification card to meet governmental regulations. Plan layout and installation of electrical wiring, equipment and fixtures, based on job specifications and local codes. Direct and train workers to install, maintain, or repair electrical wiring, equipment, and fixtures. Prepare sketches or follow blueprints to determine the location of wiring and equipment and to ensure conformance to building and safety codes. Use a variety of tools and equipment such as power construction equipment, measuring devices, power tools, and testing equipment including oscilloscopes, ammeters, and test lamps. Install ground leads and connect power cables to equipment, such as motors. Perform business management duties such as maintaining records and files, preparing reports and ordering supplies and equipment. Repair or replace wiring, equipment, and fixtures, using hand tools and power tools. Work from ladders, scaffolds, and roofs to install, maintain or repair electrical wiring, equipment, and fixtures. Place conduit (pipes or tubing) inside designated partitions, walls, or other concealed areas, and pull insulated wires or cables through the conduit to complete circuits between boxes. Construct and fabricate parts, using hand tools and specifications. Fasten small metal or plastic boxes to walls to house electrical switches or outlets. Perform physically demanding tasks, such as digging trenches to lay conduit and moving and lifting heavy objects. Provide preliminary sketches and cost estimates for materials and services. Provide assistance during emergencies by operating floodlights and generators, placing flares, and driving needed vehicles. 

 Competencies 
 Result Oriented Knowledge of Business Customer Focus Teamwork Adaptability Communication skills Problem Solving and Decision making

title: Hiring Alert | Network Operations Engineer L2
description:
Role & responsibilities As a Network Operations Engineer to develop and maintain functional and secure networks. You will mentor a team of engineers to troubleshoot and optimize our networks for our users. In this role, you should have excellent problem-solving skills and thorough knowledge of network administration and architecture. If youre also passionate about security and data protection, we’d like to meet you. Also, we can say that L2 Network Operations Engineer’s roles and responsibilities include the following. 
 What you’ll do as the (Network Operations Engineer – L2): The requirements below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. This job description is not intended to be a comprehensive list of the duties and responsibilities of the position, and the duties and responsibilities may change without notice. Knowledge & experience on routing protocols like BGP, OSPF, Static Routing, BFD etc. Knowledge of ACI & should know terminology like VLAN. Switching technology, VLAN, Spanning-tree, VTP, ACL etc. Knowledge of Multicast routing, PIM, IGMP protocols, SPT etc. Experience & hands on with Switches and Firewalls of different vendors like Cisco, FortiGate & Palo Alto. Should have experience & knowledge of the Nexus family, e.g., VPC, VDC, MEC, orphan port management. Excellent knowledge of TCP/IP, IPSec, PPP, HSRP, VRRP, redundancy protocol, IPSLA and SNMP protocols. Experience with monitoring tools such as NMS, WhatsUp Gold, and MultiPing. WLC management. Troubleshooting and coordinating with Cisco TAC, Arista TAC, and Huawei TAC, and following up on issues. Monitor system resource utilization, trending, and capacity planning. Provide L-2 support and troubleshooting to resolve issues. Work within established configuration and change management policies to ensure awareness, approval and success of changes made to the network infrastructure. Select and implement security tools, policies, and procedures in conjunction with the company’s security team. Liaise with vendors and other IT personnel for problem resolution. Design and deploy company LANs, WANs, and wireless networks, including servers, routers, switches, UPSs, and other hardware. Design, implement, and support firewalls, site-to-site VPNs, and remote-access VPNs. Perform server and security audits, and system backups and recovery. Exposure to AWS Environment. Proven hands-on network engineering experience. Solid understanding of the OSI or TCP/IP model. Good understanding of networking protocols. (e.g., IPSEC, HSRP, BGP, OSPF, 802.11, QoS) What you will bring to the team: Minimum 5+ Years of experience with relevant certifications. L2 engineer with good DC R& S experience. (approx. 5-7 years of exp.) Configure and install various network devices and services (e.g., routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, VPN, QoS) preferably Cisco Devices. Perform network maintenance and system upgrades including service packs, patches, hot fixes and security configurations. Monitor performance and ensure system availability and reliability. Oversee new and existing equipment, hardware, and software upgrades. Hands-on experience with monitoring, network diagnostic and network analytics tools. A bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field is required CCNA (required); CCNP (highly valued)

Work closely with HR, hiring managers, technical leads, department heads, and management to understand manpower requirements. Ensure timely closure of assigned vacancies. B. IT Recruitment 
Handle recruitment for various technology roles such as:
 Software Developers Full Stack Developers Front-End Developers Backend Developers Python Developers Java Developers MERN Developers React.js / Next.js Developers Mobile App Developers QA / Software Test Engineers Automation Test Engineers DevOps Engineers Cloud Engineers AWS / Azure / GCP Engineers UI/UX Designers Data Engineers AI/ML Engineers AI/LLM Engineers Technical Product Managers Project Managers Business Analysts Technical Support Engineers Other IT and SaaS-related positions The recruiter should be able to understand basic technical terminology and identify whether a candidate's profile broadly matches the JD before forwarding it to the technical team.
 C. Non-IT Recruitment 
Handle recruitment for positions such as:
 HR Executives HR Recruiters HR Managers Sales Executives Business Development Executives BDE / BDM Inside Sales Marketing Executives Digital Marketing Content Writers Operations Executives Administration Finance / Accounts Customer Support Telecalling Office Administration Other corporate and operational positions 
 2. Candidate Sourcing 
Use multiple channels to identify and attract suitable candidates.
 Recruitment Platforms 
 Naukri LinkedIn Indeed TimesJobs Foundit Internshala Other relevant job portals Other Sourcing Methods 
 LinkedIn Recruiter / LinkedIn sourcing Boolean search X-Ray search Database search Employee referrals Internal candidate database Social media recruitment Direct candidate outreach Recruitment communities and professional networks References and employee networks The recruiter should continuously develop and maintain a candidate database/talent pool for frequently hired positions.

 3. Job Posting & Job Portal Management 
 Post vacancies across relevant job portals. Create attractive and accurate job advertisements. Ensure JDs clearly mention: Job title Experience Skills Location Work mode Salary/CTC range where applicable Responsibilities Qualification Interview process 
 Monitor applications received from different platforms. Search existing databases using appropriate keywords. Refresh and optimize job postings when required. Maintain records of job postings and candidate responses. 
 4. Resume Screening & Shortlisting 
 Review resumes received from job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, and other sources. Compare candidate profiles against the approved JD. Check: Relevant experience Technical skills Industry experience Educational qualification Current location Notice period Current CTC Expected CTC Career stability Relevant project experience 
 Identify employment gaps or frequent job changes where relevant. Shortlist candidates who meet the basic requirements. Avoid forwarding profiles that clearly do not match the mandatory requirements. Maintain proper screening notes for shortlisted candidates. 
 5. Initial HR Screening 
Conduct initial telephonic/online HR screening with candidates.
Evaluate:
 Communication skills Professional attitude Relevant experience Technical exposure at a basic screening level Current role and responsibilities Project experience Career objectives Notice period Current CTC Expected CTC Location Relocation willingness Work-from-office / hybrid / remote preference Reason for job change Availability for interviews Overall suitability for the position Maintain proper screening records and share relevant candidate information with the hiring team.

 6. Interview Coordination 
 Coordinate technical, HR, managerial, and final-round interviews. Schedule interviews based on interviewer and candidate availability. Send interview invitations and joining instructions. Confirm candidate availability before every interview. Share candidate profiles and screening details with interviewers. Follow up with interview panels for feedback. Update candidates regarding interview status. Reschedule interviews when required. Minimize interview no-shows through proper follow-up. Candidate Follow-Up 
Maintain regular communication with candidates regarding:
 Interview schedule Interview confirmation Feedback Next rounds Documentation Salary discussion Offer status Joining date Joining confirmation 
 7. Candidate Evaluation & Feedback Management 
 Collect interview feedback from interviewers on time. Maintain accurate interview status. Communicate selection/rejection/hold status professionally. Maintain candidate records throughout the recruitment lifecycle. Escalate delayed feedback to the appropriate HR/hiring manager. Ensure candidates are not left without communication for extended periods. 
 8. Salary Discussion & Negotiation 
 Discuss salary expectations during the initial screening stage. Understand the candidate's current CTC and expected CTC. Communicate the approved salary budget transparently where applicable. Identify compensation mismatches at an early stage. Negotiate within the approved company budget. Coordinate with management/HR for exceptional compensation cases. Avoid proceeding with candidates whose expectations are clearly outside the approved budget unless specifically authorized. Maintain confidentiality of compensation information. 
 9. Offer & Pre-Joining Coordination 
After candidate selection:
 Collect required candidate information. Coordinate salary approval. Prepare/share offer-related information with HR. Follow up for offer acceptance. Confirm expected joining date. Maintain regular pre-joining communication. Send joining reminders. Track candidates who have accepted offers. Identify potential dropouts before joining. Maintain backup candidates for critical positions. Coordinate documentation required for joining. 
 10. Joining & Onboarding Support 
Support HR in the joining process by coordinating:
 Joining date confirmation Reporting time Required documents Employee information Offer/appointment documentation Policy acknowledgement Background verification where applicable HR induction coordination Department introduction Employee onboarding status Maintain accurate records of candidates who have:
 Applied Screened Shortlisted Interviewed Selected Offered Accepted Joined 

 11. Recruitment MIS & Reporting 
Maintain daily/weekly/monthly recruitment reports.
Track:
 Total requirements Open positions Profiles sourced Profiles screened Profiles shortlisted Interviews scheduled Interviews completed Selected candidates Offers released Offers accepted Candidates joined Candidates rejected Candidates on hold Candidate dropouts Notice periods Source of candidates Time taken to close positions Prepare recruitment MIS reports for HR and management whenever required.

 12. Recruitment Performance Metrics 
The recruiter will be expected to monitor and improve:
 Number of profiles sourced Number of qualified profiles Screening-to-interview ratio Interview-to-selection ratio Selection-to-joining ratio Offer acceptance rate Joining conversion rate Time-to-hire Time-to-close Source effectiveness Candidate quality Interview attendance rate Candidate dropout rate 
 13. Stakeholder Coordination 
Work closely with:
 Senior HR HR Manager Hiring Managers Technical Managers Team Leads Project Managers Department Heads Management Understand hiring priorities and provide regular updates regarding recruitment progress.

 14. Candidate Relationship Management 
 Build professional relationships with candidates. Maintain a strong candidate pipeline. Keep potential candidates engaged for future requirements. Maintain a database of rejected/hold candidates who may fit future openings. Ensure professional communication even when candidates are rejected. Protect candidate confidentiality and personal information. Represent the company professionally during candidate interactions. 
 15. Recruitment Process Improvement 
 Identify bottlenecks in the hiring process. Suggest improvements to sourcing and screening methods. Improve candidate response and interview attendance rates. Explore new recruitment channels. Maintain updated sourcing strategies for difficult-to-hire technical positions. Develop talent pools for recurring positions. Track recruitment trends and competitor hiring practices. 
 16. Basic Technical Understanding IT Recruitment 
The recruiter should have a basic understanding of commonly used technology terms, including:
 Programming / Development 
 Python Java JavaScript TypeScript Node.js React.js Next.js Angular .NET Backend / API 
 REST API FastAPI Django Flask Express.js Database 
 MySQL PostgreSQL MongoDB Redis Cloud / DevOps 
 AWS Azure Google Cloud Docker Kubernetes CI/CD Git Linux AI / ML 
 Artificial Intelligence Machine Learning Generative AI LLM RAG Vector Database Prompt Engineering Embeddings The recruiter is not expected to be a technical expert , but should understand the basic terminology sufficiently to identify relevant profiles and conduct an initial screening.

 17. Non-IT Recruitment Knowledge 
The recruiter should be capable of understanding and hiring for business functions such as:
 Sales Marketing Finance Accounts HR Administration Operations Customer Support Business Development Management Back-office operations The recruiter should understand differences between job roles and identify candidates based on relevant experience rather than only job titles.

 18. Required Skills 
 Technical / Recruitment Skills 
 Job portal handling LinkedIn sourcing Boolean search Resume screening Candidate database management Interview scheduling Recruitment MIS Excel / Google Sheets Email communication Basic ATS knowledge Candidate tracking Soft Skills 
 Excellent verbal communication Good written communication Strong follow-up skills Negotiation skills Time management Multitasking Team coordination Problem-solving Professional attitude Attention to detail Target orientation Candidate relationship management 
 19. Qualification 
 Education: 
 Bachelor's degree in HR, Business Administration, Management, or a related discipline. MBA/PGDM in HR will be an added advantage. Experience: 
 12 years of experience in recruitment / talent acquisition. Experience handling both IT and Non-IT recruitment is preferred. Candidates with experience in IT staffing, SaaS, software companies, technology startups, or recruitment agencies will be preferred. 
 20. Preferred Candidate Profile 
The ideal candidate should:
 Have hands-on recruitment experience. Be comfortable handling multiple vacancies simultaneously. Have experience sourcing candidates through job portals and LinkedIn. Understand basic IT technologies and job roles. Have strong candidate screening skills. Be comfortable with targets and recruitment timelines. Have excellent follow-up and coordination skills. Be comfortable communicating with candidates and hiring managers. Be organized and capable of maintaining recruitment MIS. Be proactive in finding candidates rather than relying only on applications. 
 21. Key Competencies 
 CompetencyExpected Level IT RecruitmentGoodNon-IT RecruitmentGoodCandidate SourcingGoodResume ScreeningGoodLinkedIn SourcingGoodJob Portal ManagementGoodBoolean SearchGoodInterview CoordinationExcellentSalary NegotiationGoodCandidate Follow-upExcellentRecruitment MISGoodCommunicationExcellentStakeholder ManagementGoodTime ManagementExcellentMultitaskingExcellent
 22. Performance Expectations 
During the first few months, the recruiter is expected to demonstrate the ability to:
 Understand company recruitment requirements quickly. Source relevant candidates consistently. Maintain an active candidate pipeline. Reduce irrelevant profile submissions. Coordinate interviews efficiently. Maintain accurate recruitment records. Improve candidate response and interview attendance. Close assigned positions within agreed timelines. Maintain professional candidate communication. Support the HR team in meeting overall manpower requirements. 
 23. Key Deliverables 
The HR Recruiter will be responsible for:
 Timely sourcing of qualified candidates. Effective screening and shortlisting. Maintaining candidate pipelines. Coordinating interviews. Collecting interview feedback. Supporting salary discussions. Managing offer follow-ups. Ensuring joining confirmations. Maintaining recruitment MIS. Supporting successful closure of IT and Non-IT vacancies. Maintaining candidate database. Providing regular recruitment updates to HR and management.

title: PBCS Functional Consultant - Immediate Hiring - Mastek
description:
Please find the job description for the role of Oracle PBCS Functional Consultant. 
 Job Title: Oracle PBCS Functional Consultant Experience: 5+ years of relevant experience in Oracle PBCS / EPM Cloud or Hyperion Planning Company: Mastek Limited Location: Ahmedabad/Mumbai/Noida/Chennai/Trichy/Hyderabad (Hybrid) Shift : UK/US Shift 
 About Us 
 Mastek Limited is a trusted digital engineering and cloud transformation partner for enterprises across the globe. The company focuses on delivering business value through technology, combining deep domain expertise with modern engineering practices. Teams at Mastek collaborate in an inclusive environment that values integrity, learning, and innovation. Mastek is committed to building a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture where every individual is respected, supported, and empowered to contribute. Candidates from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply. 
 Job Summary 
 Mastek is seeking a proficient Oracle PBCS Functional Consultant to join the Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) practice. The consultant will be responsible for designing, configuring, and supporting Oracle Planning and Budgeting Cloud Service (PBCS) solutions for enterprise clients, primarily in the finance domain. The role involves working closely with finance stakeholders to understand budgeting, forecasting, and reporting requirements, translating them into scalable Oracle PBCS solutions, and ensuring smooth implementation and adoption. This position is ideal for a finance professional (CA or MBA Finance) with hands-on Oracle PBCS experience and a strong interest in technology-enabled performance management. 
 Key Responsibilities 
Solution Design & Implementation Collaborate with business and finance stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document planning, budgeting, and forecasting requirements. Design end-to-end Oracle PBCS solutions, including data models, forms, business rules, calculations, and workflows. Configure PBCS applications (modules, dimensions, hierarchies, security, and metadata) in line with best practices. Develop and maintain input forms, dashboards, reports, and task lists to support planning and reporting processes. Participate in full project lifecycle activities: requirement analysis, solution design, build, testing, deployment, and post-go-live support. Functional & Process Expertise
 Map existing financial planning and budgeting processes to Oracle PBCS capabilities and recommend process improvements. Design and implement driver-based planning models, rolling forecasts, and scenario planning. Work with finance teams to align PBCS solutions with corporate budgeting, management reporting, and financial consolidation processes. Provide functional guidance on integration with upstream and downstream systems (ERP, data warehouses, reporting tools). Configuration, Testing & Documentation
 Configure business rules, calculations, allocations, and validations within PBCS. Support data integration and data management activities, including data loads, mappings, and validation. Develop and execute test scenarios and test scripts for unit testing, system integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT). Prepare functional design documents, configuration documents, user guides, and training materials. Stakeholder Management & Support
 Serve as a primary functional point of contact for clients on Oracle PBCS-related topics. Conduct user training sessions and workshops to drive solution adoption. Provide ongoing production support, troubleshooting issues, and implementing enhancements. Collaborate with technical teams, project managers, and other consultants to ensure timely and quality delivery. Governance & Continuous Improvement
 Adhere to project governance, documentation standards, and change management processes. Stay current with Oracle EPM Cloud / PBCS updates, new features, and industry best practices. Recommend continuous improvements to existing PBCS implementations to enhance performance, usability, and value. 
 Qualifications 5+ years of overall experience, with at least 3 years of hands-on experience as an Oracle PBCS / EPM Cloud / Hyperion Planning functional consultant. Proven experience in: Designing and implementing Oracle PBCS planning applications. Building and managing dimensions, metadata, and data forms. Creating and maintaining business rules, calculations, and allocations. Supporting budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting processes. Proficient understanding of: Financial planning and analysis (FP&A) concepts such as budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and scenario planning. Income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, and key financial metrics. Experience in data integration and data management within PBCS (e.g., Data Management / Data Management integrations, flat file loads, ERP integrations). Skilled in working with stakeholders from finance and IT, translating business requirements into functional solutions. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills. Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work independently and as part of a distributed team. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with other Oracle EPM Cloud modules (e.g., EPBCS, FCCS, ARCS, PCMCS) or on-premises Hyperion applications. Oracle EPM Cloud / PBCS-related certifications. Experience with Oracle ERP (E-Business Suite, Oracle Cloud ERP) or other ERP systems. Exposure to scripting or automation in the EPM context (e.g., Groovy, calculation scripts, EPM Automate). Experience working in consulting environments or on multi-country / global implementations.

Key Skills: PBCS,Epbcs,Hyperion Planning,Hyperion,Oracle EPM,EPM,Planning,Consulting

Position Description Position: US Recruiter (Salaried) Shift: 5.30 PM 2.30 AM Job Classification: Back Office - HR Reports To: Team Leader Location: Bangalore, Karnataka, India Date: 26th August 2026 
 Company Overview JB Poindexter (India) Private Limited is a subsidiary of J.B. Poindexter & Co., Inc. a privately held diversified manufacturing company forecasting $2.4B in annual revenue and 8,000 team members in 2024. The eight operating subsidiaries, covering over 50 locations, are engaged in the production of commercial truck bodies, step-vans, utility trucks, funeral coaches, limousines, pickup truck bed enclosures, precision machining, and expandable foam plastic packaging. For more information, visit www.jbpoindexter.com JB Poindexter (India) Private Limited is the captive shared services unit of the J.B. Poindexter & Co., Inc. The company, wholly owned by J. B. Poindexter & Co., Inc. & is headquartered in Houston, Texas, USA. POSITION SUMMARY The US Recruiter – Salaried Roles will be responsible for managing the full-cycle recruitment process for salaried positions across the organization’s US operations. The role will partner closely with hiring managers, HR Business Partners, and Talent Acquisition leadership to understand business requirements, develop effective recruitment strategies, identify and attract qualified candidates, and drive positions through the recruitment process to successful offer and hire. The ideal candidate will have strong experience recruiting for US-based salaried/professional positions and will be comfortable managing multiple requisitions in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. The recruiter will be expected to build strong candidate pipelines, including passive talent, while providing an excellent candidate and hiring-manager experience. Success in this role will require strong sourcing capability, stakeholder management, candidate assessment skills, organisation, attention to detail, and the ability to deliver against recruitment metrics such as time to fill, quality of hire, pipeline health, and overall hiring outcomes. KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES Full-Cycle Recruitment Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle for US-based salaried positions, from preparing job requisition and posting it, sourcing, screening, interview coordination, selection, offer, and handoff to onboarding. Manage multiple open requisitions simultaneously while effectively prioritising roles based on business requirements and hiring timelines. Follow established Talent Acquisition processes and procedures to efficiently and effectively fill salaried positions. Partner with hiring managers to understand position requirements, critical competencies, experience, qualifications, and business needs. Develop and execute recruiting plans and sourcing strategies based on the requirements of each position. Maintain ownership of assigned requisitions and proactively communicate progress, challenges, and potential risks. Sourcing & Talent Pipeline Development Utilize job boards, professional networks, internal databases, referrals, and other recruiting resources to identify qualified candidates. Develop strong pipelines of qualified candidates for current and future salaried hiring needs. Proactively identify and engage passive candidates through targeted sourcing and networking. Build and maintain professional networks to support ongoing US salaried recruitment. Research and identify new sourcing channels and approaches to improve candidate generation. Create and maintain compelling job postings aligned with the requirements of each position. Candidate Screening & Assessment Review resumes and applications and evaluate candidate qualifications against position requirements. Conduct initial phone/video screens to assess candidates' work history, education, experience, skills, career interests, compensation expectations, and overall fit. Assess candidates against defined competencies and job requirements and provide recommendations to hiring managers. Maintain a consistent and objective candidate assessment process. Ensure candidates receive timely communication and a positive recruitment experience throughout the hiring process. Coordinate and participate in video and/or onsite interviews as required. Provide guidance to hiring managers on candidate selection and recruitment best practices. Hiring Manager & Stakeholder Partnership Develop strong working relationships with hiring managers and business leaders supporting salaried recruitment. Conduct recruitment intake discussions and establish clear recruiting plans for assigned positions. Consult with hiring managers throughout the recruitment process and provide market and candidate insights. Educate new hiring managers on Talent Acquisition processes, workflows, interview practices, and expectations. Partner with HR Business Partners and Talent Acquisition leadership to address recruitment challenges and hiring risks. Maintain regular communication with stakeholders regarding pipeline status, candidate activity, interview progress, and expected hiring timelines. Offer & Pre-Employment Process Manage the candidate offer process in partnership with the hiring manager and appropriate HR stakeholders. Coordinate required background checks and other pre-employment activities. Maintain timely communication with candidates throughout the offer and pre-employment process. Support the transition of selected candidates into the onboarding process. Reporting & Recruitment Metrics Maintain accurate and timely recruitment activity within the Applicant Tracking System. Track and report recruitment metrics including open requisitions, candidate pipelines, interview activity, offers, time to fill, and hiring status. Provide transparent updates to Talent Acquisition leadership, hiring managers, and HR Business Partners. Proactively identify barriers that may impact hiring timelines and recommend solutions. Maintain accurate records related to recruitment activities and candidate status. Talent Acquisition & Process Improvement Participate in Talent Acquisition initiatives designed to improve recruiting effectiveness and candidate experience. Identify opportunities to improve sourcing strategies, recruiting processes, and candidate pipelines. Support workforce planning and recruitment initiatives as required. Contribute to the development and implementation of best practices for salaried recruitment. Complete special projects and other Talent Acquisition activities as assigned. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree 5 to 7 years of experience in recruitment, sourcing, Talent Acquisition, or related experience. Experience recruiting for US-based positions in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Experience managing full-cycle recruitment processes. Strong experience sourcing and screening candidates for salaried/professional positions. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with candidates, hiring managers, and senior stakeholders. Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities. Strong attention to detail and follow-through. Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a Talent Acquisition team. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Proven experience recruiting for US salaried/professional positions. Experience recruiting across multiple business functions. Strong passive candidate sourcing and talent-pipeline development experience. Experience using Applicant Tracking Systems and recruiting technologies. Experience with Ceridian Dayforce or other comparable ATS/HRIS systems. Experience with LinkedIn and other professional sourcing platforms. Experience partnering directly with US-based hiring managers. Understanding of US recruitment practices and employment requirements. Experience working with recruitment metrics such as time to fill, pipeline conversion, and quality of hire.

We offer competitive salary and perks and a meritocracy driven career growth path. Job Description & Responsibilities We are looking for a results-driven Recruitment Executive to support our IT hiring and staffing business. The role will be responsible for sourcing, screening, engaging and closing technology talent across multiple skill sets, while working closely with hiring managers, business teams and staffing stakeholders. The ideal candidate should have strong exposure to IT recruitment/staffing, lateral hiring, candidate engagement and recruitment delivery , with the ability to manage multiple requirements and hiring priorities simultaneously.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 1. IT Recruitment & Staffing 
 Manage end-to-end recruitment for IT and technology positions across lateral and volume hiring requirements. Understand job requirements, technical skills, experience and business context to identify relevant talent. Source candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, internal databases, referrals, social platforms and other channels. Build and maintain a strong pipeline of qualified IT professionals across key technology skill areas. Handle multiple open positions and staffing requirements simultaneously while maintaining delivery timelines. 
 2. Candidate Management 
 Conduct initial screening and assess candidates against technical, experience and behavioural requirements. Drive candidate engagement throughout the recruitment process and ensure a positive candidate experience. Coordinate interviews, feedback, documentation, compensation discussions and offer closure. Maintain regular communication with candidates to improve conversion and reduce drop-offs. Build long-term talent pools for frequently hired technology skills. 
 3. Stakeholder & Hiring Manager Management 
 Work closely with recruiters, hiring managers, delivery teams and business stakeholders to understand current and future hiring needs. Provide regular updates on recruitment progress, pipeline quality, ageing positions and hiring challenges. Seek feedback on candidate quality and continuously refine sourcing and screening strategies. Escalate hiring risks and bottlenecks proactively. 
 4. Staffing / Deployment Support 
 Support staffing requirements by identifying candidates aligned to specific project, client or deployment needs. Work with staffing teams to understand project requirements, availability and deployment timelines. Maintain visibility of candidate status from sourcing through selection, offer and joining. Support quick turnaround hiring for critical project requirements. 
 5. Recruitment Operations & MIS 
 Maintain accurate candidate records and recruitment data in the ATS/recruitment trackers. Track key recruitment metrics such as CV submissions, interview ratios, selection ratios, offer-to-join ratios, TAT and ageing positions . Prepare regular recruitment dashboards and hiring reports. Ensure adherence to recruitment processes, documentation and compliance requirements. 
 Success Measures

 Hiring Delivery | Time-to-Fill | Pipeline Quality | CV-to-Interview Conversion | Interview-to-Selection Conversion | Offer-to-Join Ratio | Candidate Experience | Stakeholder SatisfactionSkills: Strong understanding of IT recruitment and technology staffing Hands-on experience with lateral hiring and volume hiring Good understanding of common IT skills such as Java, .NET, SAP, Cloud, Data, DevOps, Testing, ERP, etc. Strong sourcing and candidate identification skills Good understanding of LinkedIn, job portals and digital sourcing channels Strong candidate engagement and negotiation skills Ability to work on multiple requirements under tight timelines Strong communication and stakeholder management skills Data-driven and target-oriented approach High ownership, responsiveness and follow-through Qualification: Post Graduate Experience Desired: 3-8 Yrs in IT recruitment / IT staffing / RPO / recruitment consulting

description:
JOB DESCRIPTION: 
 International Voice Process - Customer Support 
 Work Location -Bangalore Electronic City
 Experience - 0 TO 3 Years 
 Salary - Up to  5.5 Lakhs per Annum 
 Night Rotational Shifts 
 Weekly Offs - Rotational Offs 
 Interview Mode - Virtual Interview 
 Interview Rounds : HR/OPS/SHL Test
 Selection TAT - 1 Day Selection 
 Immediate Onboarding 
 Position Overview 
 We are looking for enthusiastic and customer-focused candidates to join an International Voice Process in 
 Bangalore Electronic City. The role involves handling international customers over voice, understanding their 
 concerns, providing accurate resolutions, and delivering a high-quality customer experience. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Handle inbound and/or outbound voice interactions with international customers. 
Understand customer queries and provide appropriate, timely and accurate resolutions. 
 Maintain professional communication and demonstrate strong customer-handling skills. 
 Follow process guidelines, quality standards, compliance requirements and escalation procedures. 
 Document customer interactions accurately in the relevant systems. 
 Meet defined productivity, quality, customer satisfaction and service-level targets. 
 Coordinate with internal teams wherever escalation or additional support is required. 
 Maintain a positive and professional approach while working in a fast-paced BPO environment. 
 Candidate Eligibility 
 Experience: 0 TO3 years; freshers may also be considered based on communication and process fit. 
 Strong verbal communication skills in English. 
 Comfortable communicating with international customers over the phone. 
Willingness to work in night rotational shifts and rotational weekly offs. 
 Good listening, problem-solving and customer-service skills. 
 Basic computer knowledge and ability to work with multiple systems. 
 Candidates should be comfortable with immediate joining. 
 
 
 Interview & Selection Process 
 1. HR Round: Initial screening and communication assessment. 
 2. OPS Round: Operations/process suitability and customer-handling assessment. 
 3. SHL Test: Online assessment as applicable to the hiring process. 
 4. Selection Timeline: Candidates can complete the selection process within 1 day, subject to successful 
 completion of all rounds. 
 5. Interview Mode: Virtual Interview. 
 Compensation & Joining 
 Salary: Up to  5.5 Lakhs per annum, depending on experience, skills, interview performance and applicable 
 company salary structure. 
 Onboarding: Immediate onboarding for selected candidates, subject to completion of the required documentation 
 and company joining formalities. 
 Apply Now 
 If you have strong English communication skills and are looking for an opportunity in an international 
 customer service voice process, apply for this position and be ready for a fast-track virtual selection process.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
About the Role 
 We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Senior Manager Talent Acquisition to lead and manage end-to-end recruitment across junior, mid-level, and senior positions. The ideal candidate should have 8+ years of professional experience, with the majority of their career focused on Human Resources and Talent Acquisition . The candidate should have strong expertise in understanding business requirements, developing effective sourcing strategies, managing stakeholders, and successfully closing positions across different levels of the organization. Strong communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills are essential for this role. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Lead end-to-end Talent Acquisition processes, from understanding manpower requirements to candidate onboarding. Partner closely with business leaders and hiring managers to understand role requirements, team structures, skill requirements, and hiring priorities. Manage hiring for junior, mid-level, and senior positions , with the ability to independently handle critical and leadership-level mandates. Develop and execute effective sourcing strategies using job portals, LinkedIn, employee referrals, internal talent pools, campus hiring, professional networks, and other relevant channels. Conduct candidate screening and evaluate candidates based on technical/functional skills, experience, cultural fit, career aspirations, and organizational requirements. Own the recruitment pipeline and ensure timely movement of candidates through the various stages of the hiring process. Drive offer negotiation and closure , effectively managing candidate expectations around compensation, role, location, notice period, and career opportunities. Build strong relationships with candidates throughout the recruitment lifecycle to ensure a positive candidate experience. Work closely with senior stakeholders and hiring managers to provide regular updates on hiring progress, challenges, market availability, and expected closure timelines. Provide insights on talent availability, compensation benchmarks, market trends, and competitor hiring practices to support business hiring decisions. Identify bottlenecks in the recruitment process and implement initiatives to improve Time-to-Hire, Quality of Hire, Offer-to-Joining ratio, and overall recruitment efficiency . Maintain accurate recruitment data, dashboards, MIS, and hiring reports. Mentor and guide junior members of the Talent Acquisition team and support them in managing complex hiring requirements. Contribute to the development and implementation of Talent Acquisition strategies, processes, and best practices . Key Skills & Competencies 8+ years of overall professional experience , with substantial experience in HR and Talent Acquisition. Strong hands-on experience in end-to-end recruitment across multiple levels and functions. Proven ability to successfully close both junior and senior-level positions , including niche and critical roles. Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with candidates and senior stakeholders. Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills . Excellent candidate assessment, interviewing, negotiation, and closing skills. Strong understanding of sourcing channels and recruitment market dynamics. Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into effective hiring strategies. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven approach to recruitment. Ability to manage multiple hiring mandates and priorities in a fast-paced environment. Strong ownership, accountability, and execution orientation. Ability to work independently while also mentoring and collaborating with the wider TA/HR team. Preferred Profile MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or a relevant qualification is preferred. Experience in a corporate Talent Acquisition / HR environment is preferred. Experience handling leadership, managerial, and critical hiring mandates will be an advantage. Prior experience in managing or mentoring a Talent Acquisition team will be preferred. 
 Success in This Role 
 The successful candidate will be expected to build strong stakeholder relationships, maintain a healthy and high-quality talent pipeline, independently drive complex hiring mandates, and consistently deliver timely and quality closures across levels .
